args.command:
cd . && cp inbox/06-06/委托.csv scratch/inbox/ && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
station={'J01':'东港','J02':'东港','J03':'东港','J04':'西湾','J05':'西湾','J06':'西湾',
         'J07':'南站','J08':'南站','J09':'南站','J10':'北仓','J11':'北仓','J12':'北仓'}
obj={r['案号']:r['对象'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('input/站务/章程.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
dele={r['站']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('inbox/06-06/委托.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
rows=[]
for c in sorted(station,key=lambda x:int(x[1:])):
    s=station[c]; d=dele[s]
    rows.append([c,d['代办系列'],d['末日']])
    ser=obj[c].split('-')[1]
    flag='' if ser==d['代办系列'] else '  <-- 本案系列%s与本站代办系列%s不符'%(ser,d['代办系列'])
    print(c,obj[c],s,'代办系列',d['代办系列'],'开始',d['开始'],'末日',d['末日'],flag)
with open('out/委托.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n'); w.writerow(['案号','本站代办系列','本站代办末日']); w.writerows(rows)
print(open('out/委托.csv',encoding='utf-8').read())
PY
